name: hiphop
character: beat, bass and sample or vocal loop: a groove piece whose loop is the hook and whose variation is arrangement and mutes
why: a shipped starting point for `gate_profiles.py new <name> --from hiphop`: the figures are starting values chosen for the genre structure, not measurements of a piece; measure with scripts/rca.py and state the real figures in the project profile

pattern.loop_short.reason: a sample or 808 loop is the genre; sections change by what enters and leaves

pattern.drums_few.reason: a repeated drum bar is the groove, hats roll and fills mark the section

pattern.velocity_flat.reason: a programmed hat or 808 line is written near-flat and swung; the ghost-note pattern, not velocity sd, carries the groove
